name: WiFiClientConnect
description: WiFi/examples/WiFiClientConnect, unmodified: the sketch joins the access point named in it (your-ssid, WPA2 with your-password, on channel 11, 5 m away): the scan, authentication, association, the WPA2 four-way handshake and DHCP run over the air as on a real board, and it prints the address the access point's DHCP server leases it.
